defects.description: The index treats equal fingerprints as identical content and returns the earlier document's identifier for a distinct document. The minimal correction makes the index key include content as well as its fingerprint.

trigger.input: Supply fingerprint=text=>String(text.length), put 'reed' then 'lake', then put 'reed' again and read both distinct documents.
trigger.expected: Two distinct identifiers with their original content; the third put returns the first identifier.
trigger.actual: All puts return the first identifier and reading the second identifier returns 'reed'.

defects.why_missed: The suite only uses SHA-256. No fingerprint adapter or collision data exists; changing a string literal does not supply the required indexing scenario.

defects.description: Evaluation parses output without checking completion status. A diagnostic beginning with a number silently overwrites a previously valid score.

trigger.input: Supply an evaluator that first returns {status:0,output:'3'}, then {status:2,output:'12 records unavailable'}; put a document and evaluate it twice.

defects.why_missed: The suite uses only the successful built-in evaluator. It has no evaluator fake, completion-status response or repeated evaluation.
